Usage: codex exec [OPTIONS] [PROMPT]
Arguments:
  [PROMPT]
          Initial instructions for the agent.
          If not provided as an argument (or if `-` is used), instructions are read from stdin.
Options:
  --output-schema <FILE>  JSON Schema for final response
  -o, --output-last-message <FILE>  Write the last message to a file
  -s, --sandbox <SANDBOX_MODE>
          Select the execution sandbox.
          [possible values: read-only, workspace-write, danger-full-access]
  --ignore-user-config  Do not load the user config file
  -C, --cd <DIR>  Set the working directory
  --skip-git-repo-check  Allow execution outside a Git repository
